title: Liquify
tagline: Liquify: AI-Powered Cross-Chain Stablecoin Orchestrator built on Avail Nexus.
description: A comprehensive AI-powered cross-chain stablecoin orchestration platform that transforms complex multi-chain operations into simple natural language commands. Built for the Avail Nexus hackathon with full integration of multi-agent systems, real-time DEX liquidity, and advanced visualization.
how_its_made:
🛠️ Technology Stack
- Frontend
React 18 with TypeScript
Vite for build tooling
Tailwind CSS for styling
ReactFlow for visualization
Framer Motion for animations
RainbowKit for wallet connectivity
- Backend
Cloudflare Workers with Durable Objects
Multi-Agent Orchestration system
Real-time event streaming via SSE
Caching layer with Cloudflare KV
- Blockchain & DeFi
Avail Nexus SDK for cross-chain bridging
Envio HyperSync for DEX liquidity data
Hedera Agent Kit for agent coordination
ASI Alliance uAgents for decentralized communication
